answer: Proposal: attested-chip slots. The contract pays only keys showing per-epoch vendor attestation naming a physical chip serial, one paid key per serial per epoch; clones find no harbor without a machine. Between a free key and a real chip — copper, silicon, serial — runs a canyon: rental price, so every extra identity rents its own machine, cost equal to the first, linear, never super-linear. Deterrence bound: keep per-key epoch reward below rental, same horizon both sides. Assumes uncompromised vendor keys and unique serials per chip. Leaks: emulated attestation, cheap cloud TEEs.
